# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update, including upstream Chrome fixes. Linux font fallback can select a different face after this update; use an explicit or bundled typeface when deterministic text metrics matter.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path. Applications that depend on an exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when selection must be deterministic.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m153 and incorporates the corresponding upstream Chrome fixes without changing the managed API surface. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and upstream Chrome fixes.
